title: fr.linagora.twalk.bridge.status.changed.v1
description: A bridge changed state (connected, disconnected, session expired, ...). Produced by the Companion Gateway, which supervises bridge provisioning and health. This is an operational event: the network and consent extensions are declared but optional, because a bridge state change has no meaningful consent dimension.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Fixed to 1.0 for all Twalk v1 events.

id.description: Deterministic identifier computed as sha256(bridge_id + ':' + to_state + ':' + occurred_at). Re-emitting the same recorded transition produces the same id.

source.description: URI of the bridge resource on the Companion Gateway. Format: gateway://<domain>/bridges/<bridge_id>.

type.description: CloudEvents type. Reverse-DNS convention with an explicit version suffix. Any breaking change to this schema requires incrementing the suffix (v2, v3, ...) rather than mutating v1.

time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the Companion Gateway produced the event.

subject.description: Optional identifier of the bridge whose state changed. Mirrors data.bridge_id for filtering convenience.

datacontenttype.description: Fixed to application/json for all Twalk v1 events.

dataschema.description: Optional URI pointing back to this JSON Schema. Recommended for third-party consumers that validate events dynamically.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header.

network.description: Twalk extension. Optional on this operational event: when set, mirrors data.network for server-side filtering on NATS.

consent.description: Twalk extension. Optional on this operational event; bridge state changes normally carry no consent dimension.

bridge_id.description: Identifier of the bridge instance. Prefixed with bridge- even for non-Mautrix paths (e.g. bridge-sms-* for the SMS Companion) to keep the taxonomy consistent.

network.description: The network this bridge serves, as the user experiences it. SMS is sms whether the transport is mautrix-gmessages or the SMS Companion (see ADR 0005).

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the transition was observed. Part of the id natural key.

reason.description: Optional machine- or human-readable cause of the transition, e.g. 'session revoked by network'.

last_message_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of the last message seen through this bridge, for dashboard display.
